about_the_game:
🎉【Get Ready for Steam Next Fest! The Thigh Purification Rhythm, Now Unleashed!】🎉

MOMO Crash, the thigh-purification rhythm action game, now has a free demo available! Don't miss this massive wave! You're sure to find something you'll adore in this exhilarating, never-before-seen rhythm action game. Grab it with your own two hands... no, with your THIGHS!

▼A Brand-New Rhythm Action Sensation, Played with Thighs!▼

With simple controls, command those gorgeous thighs to crush a swarm of souls and more emerging from the depths of the screen! Groove to the beat and purify souls by clamping them tight... MOMO Crash is an exhilarating rhythm game with a totally fresh theme!

▼Personalities on Full Blast! Three "Thigh Warriors" Await!▼

In a world of chaos, these "Thigh Warriors" possess the one-and-only power of purification. Look forward to their cute and powerful exploits!

💎 Daia (The Uber-Confident, Unstoppable Diamond Teen)

"Fascinate, Pierce, Dominate——The Perfectly Self-Produced Thighs"

Daia, the "Jewel Girl" who shines with confidence and style! To her, "KAWAII" (cuteness) is justice and the ultimate form of self-expression. Wielding her perfectly toned "Thighs" as weapons, she fights and dazzles day in and day out to paint the world in her unique vision of "KAWAII"! Her goal: to become the president of the No.1 brand. No one can stop her ambition!

💜 Seika (The Bashful, Heart-Fluttering, Philanthropic Sister with a Locked-Up Heart)

"Wanting to be saved, wanting to save——Thighs like a Cage of Love Swirling Within"

Seika is a shy sister torn between her duties in her sacred role and her earnest desire to be needed by someone. Hidden beneath her modest sister's attire, her "Thighs" hold a benevolent power to heal the world, and a "Cage of Love" concealing passions so fierce they sometimes threaten to imprison her. With those legs, what will she grasp? World peace, or her own small measure of happiness——?

🌞 Hikaru (The Wild, Sparkling, Optimistic Traveler with an Explosive Smile)

"Zero Guilt in Destruction——The Naive Hyper-Crush Thighs"

"I want to make everyone smile!" With this pure wish as her sole guide, the innocent traveler Hikaru journeys the world! To find her missing sister, she heroically CRUSHES any obstacle with her prized "Reinforced Thighs"! Bright as the sun, her destructive power comes with absolutely no ill-will or guilt, of course!

▼Be the First to Play the Demo! Core Gameplay Deep Dive!▼

In this demo, you can be among the first to fully experience the oh-so-satisfying core gameplay of MOMO Crash!

Basic controls are just two simple actions: "Clamp" and "Kick"! Three types of targets, each with different characteristics, will come flying from the back of the screen to the rhythm. Deal with each one precisely using the right action!

👻Approaching 《Souls》: Match the timing and gently Catch & Hold them with your thighs to Purify!

🦠However, for the 《Viruses》 that sometimes sneak in: Match the beat and sharply Kick & Crush them with your thighs to repel!

🐈Whoops, for the cute 《Kitties》 that appear from time to time... you absolutely MUST NOT attack them by mistake! Gently offer your lap and let them rest comfortably until they're satisfied.

"Clamp to Purify + Kick to Destroy + And Sometimes Pet a Kitty (?)" ── These simple, yet surprisingly deep, actions say it all...!

What's more! You can play several "KAWAII x Upbeat" songs from the full version of the game! Not only EASY and NORMAL modes, but you can also be among the first to enjoy HARD mode! Put your rhythm sense and thigh power to the ultimate test!

(※ Gameplay content in this demo is from a version currently under development and may differ in the final product.)

▼From the Developers, With All Our Love and... "Thighs"!▼

MOMO Crash was born from a creator's simple desire: "I want to draw cute girls!" It's a labor of love, fueled by our development team's heartfelt conviction that "Thighs are, after all, the BEST...!" and our pure passion "to make the most ridiculously fun rhythm game in the world, no questions asked!"

At this wonderful celebration called Steam Next Fest, we'd be absolutely over the moon if you could experience even a glimpse of the "Unapologetic Love for Thighs" and "Off-the-Charts Fun" that we've poured our entire hearts and souls into!

All the thighs we have to offer, to you——.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game does not contain nudity or direct violence, but features female characters in revealing outfits, which some players may find suggestive. Please consider this when playing.
Please note: All characters depicted in this game are adults (18 years of age or older)
